dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Hehe, pretty impressive, isn't it? This is mine and Aino's pride and joy: the Rossum Workshop's multipurpose forging device!

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Just toss in the right materials, and whether it be tools or weapons, this nifty device can pump out your product according to its standard manufacturing templates.

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: I've heard from Miss Nefer that the northerners have something similar... though I'm not sure how they power their stuff without kuuvahki.
